basic.q: Ann said, 'I am tired.' -> Ann said that she ____ tired.
basic.explanation: Doğrudan anlatımdaki geniş zaman, dolaylı anlatımda geçmiş zamana dönüşür.

basic.q: Tom said, 'I like apples.' -> Tom said that he ____ apples.
basic.explanation: Geniş zaman cümlesi reported speech yapılırken past simple (liked) olur.

basic.q: Mary said, 'I can swim.' -> Mary said that she ____ swim.
basic.explanation: Modal fiil olan 'can', dolaylı anlatımda 'could' haline gelir.

basic.q: John said, 'I live in London.' -> John said that he ____ in London.
basic.explanation: Present simple tense, reported speech kurallarına göre past simple yapılır.

basic.q: Sue said, 'I am watching TV.' -> Sue said that she ____ TV.
basic.explanation: Present continuous tense, dolaylı anlatımda past continuous (was watching) olur.

basic.q: Paul said, 'I have a car.' -> Paul said that he ____ a car.
basic.explanation: Have fiili geçmiş zamanda 'had' olarak değiştirilir.

basic.q: Kate said, 'I will call you.' -> Kate said that she ____ call me.
basic.explanation: Will kelimesi reported speech cümlelerinde would şeklini alır.

basic.q: Choose the correct reported statement for: He said, 'I am happy.'
options: He said that I am happy.
He said that he is happy.
He said that he was happy.
He said that she was happy.
basic.explanation: Özne 'he' olur ve 'am' fiili geçmiş zaman 'was' ile değiştirilir.

basic.q: Find the error in this reported statement: 'She said that she is busy.' (Direct: 'I am busy.')
basic.explanation: 'is' kelimesi 'was' olmalıdır çünkü zaman uyumu gereklidir.

basic.q: My mom said, 'Dinner is ready.' -> My mom said that dinner ____ ready.
basic.explanation: İsim cümlesindeki 'is' yardımcı fiili 'was' yapılır.

basic.q: Bob said, 'I work hard.' -> Bob said that he ____ hard.
basic.explanation: Geniş zaman olumlu cümle reported speech'te ikinci haliyle kullanılır.

basic.q: Jane said, 'I don't like milk.' -> Jane said that she ____ like milk.
basic.explanation: Olumsuz geniş zaman cümlesi 'didn't' ile geçmiş zamana çevrilir.

basic.q: Mark said, 'I played tennis.' -> Mark said that he ____ tennis.
basic.explanation: Simple past tense (played), temel düzeyde genellikle past simple olarak kalır.

basic.q: Linda said, 'I must go now.' -> Linda said that she ____ go.
basic.explanation: Must modal fiili dolaylı anlatımda genellikle 'had to' olur.

basic.q: Sam said, 'I am reading a book.' -> Sam said that he ____ a book.
basic.explanation: Present continuous tense 'was reading' şeklinde değiştirilir.

basic.q: Choose the best completion: He said that he ____ tired yesterday.
basic.explanation: Geçmiş zaman belirteci ve reported speech yapısı için 'was' uygundur.

basic.q: Dad said, 'I bought a new phone.' -> Dad said that he ____ a new phone.
basic.explanation: Doğrudan anlatımdaki 'bought' fiili dolaylı anlatımda korunabilir.

basic.q: The teacher said, 'English is easy.' -> The teacher said that English ____ easy.
basic.explanation: Genel bir ifade olsa bile dolaylı aktarımda fiil past yapıya (was) dönüşebilir.

basic.q: Helen said, 'I love my dog.' -> Helen said that she loved ____ dog.
basic.explanation: Şahıs zamirine göre iyelik sıfatı 'her' olarak uyarlanmalıdır.

basic.q: Dan said, 'I can speak French.' -> Dan said that he ____ speak French.
basic.explanation: 'Can' modal fiili reported speech cümlelerinde 'could' yapılır.

intermediate.q: She said, "I am studying for my exam now." becomes: She said that she ____ for her exam then.
intermediate.explanation: Dolaylı anlatımda 'am studying' ifadesi 'was studying' şekline dönüşür.

intermediate.q: John said, "I will finish the report tomorrow." becomes: John said that he would finish the report ____.
intermediate.explanation: 'Tomorrow' kelimesi dolaylı anlatımda 'the next day' veya 'the following day' olur.

intermediate.q: Identify the error: He told to me that he had already booked the tickets.
intermediate.explanation: 'Tell' fiili nesne alırken araya 'to' almaz, direkt 'told me' denmelidir.

intermediate.q: Mary told us, "We moved here two years ago." becomes: Mary told us that they had moved there two years ____.
intermediate.explanation: Dolaylı anlatımda 'ago' kelimesi 'before' olarak değiştirilir.

intermediate.q: "I have never seen such a beautiful sunset," Mark remarked. Mark remarked that he ____ never seen such a beautiful sunset.
intermediate.explanation: Present perfect tense ('have seen'), past perfect tense ('had seen') yapılır.

intermediate.q: Choose the correct transformation for: "I must submit this assignment by Friday," said Anna.
options: Anna said that she must submit that assignment by Friday.
Anna said that she had to submit that assignment by Friday.
Anna said that she has to submit this assignment by Friday.
Anna said that she would have to submit this assignment by Friday.
intermediate.explanation: 'Must' fiili dolaylı anlatımda genellikle 'had to'ya dönüşür.

intermediate.q: The teacher explained, "Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius." The teacher explained that water ____ at 100 degrees Celsius.
intermediate.explanation: Genel geçer gerçekler (scientific facts) dolaylı anlatımda tense değişimi yaşamaz.

intermediate.q: "If I had more time, I would travel more," she said. She said that if she ____ more time, she would travel more.
intermediate.explanation: Type 2 conditional yapıları dolaylı anlatımda genellikle tense değişimine uğramaz.

intermediate.q: Which sentence correctly reports: "I bought this car yesterday," he said.
options: He said that he bought this car yesterday.
He said that he had bought that car the day before.
He said that he has bought that car yesterday.
He said that he bought that car the previous day.
intermediate.explanation: Simple past tense 'had bought' olur, 'this' 'that' olur ve 'yesterday' değişir.

intermediate.q: "We were watching a movie when the lights went out," they said. They stated that they ____ a movie when the lights went out.
intermediate.explanation: Past continuous tense, dolaylı anlatımda past perfect continuous tense'e dönüşür.

intermediate.q: Identify the incorrect part in this reported statement: She said me that she was leaving early.
intermediate.explanation: Nesne varsa 'said me' denmez, 'told me' veya 'said to me' kullanılmalıdır.

intermediate.q: "I can speak three languages fluently," Paul boasted. Paul boasted that he ____ speak three languages fluently.
intermediate.explanation: 'Can' modal fiili dolaylı anlatımda 'could' şeklini alır.

intermediate.q: "I saw your brother at the mall today," Linda told me. Linda told me that she had seen my brother at the mall ____.
intermediate.explanation: Dolaylı anlatımda 'today' kelimesi 'that day' olarak değiştirilir.

intermediate.q: Choose the best completion: The manager announced that the new policy ____ into effect next month.
intermediate.explanation: Gelecek zamana işaret eden 'will' fiili dolaylı anlatımda 'would' olur.

intermediate.q: "I may come to the party later," Greg mentioned. Greg mentioned that he ____ come to the party later.
intermediate.explanation: 'May' modal fiili dolaylı anlatımda 'might' kelimesine dönüşür.

intermediate.q: Complete the sentence correctly: Susan explained that she couldn't attend the meeting because she ____ feeling well.
intermediate.explanation: Geçmiş zamana uyum sağlamak için 'wasn't' kullanılmalıdır.

intermediate.q: "You should apologize to her," David advised me. David advised me that I ____ apologize to her.
intermediate.explanation: 'Should' modal fiili dolaylı anlatımda genellikle değişmeden kalır.

intermediate.q: Identify the error in the reported sentence: He claimed that he is innocent of all charges.
intermediate.explanation: Ana cümle geçmiş zamanda ('claimed') olduğu için 'is' yerine 'was' kullanılmalıdır.

intermediate.q: "Don't touch that wire!" she warned. (Note: Transforming imperative to statement/report structure): She warned him ____ touch that wire.
intermediate.explanation: Olumsuz emir cümleleri rapor edilirken 'not to' yapısı kullanılır.

intermediate.q: "I haven't seen them since last week," Claire said. Claire said that she ____ them since the previous week.
intermediate.explanation: Present perfect tense ('haven't seen'), past perfect tense ('hadn't seen') olur.

advanced.q: Had they known the consequences, they ____ never agreed to the merger, the CEO remarked.
advanced.explanation: Geçmişteki bir varsayımı aktarırken üçüncü tip koşul yapısının rapor edilmiş hali korunur.

advanced.q: The diplomat stated that under no circumstances ____ the treaty be ratified in its current form.
advanced.explanation: Geçmişe dönük resmi bir açıklamada modal fiilin geçmiş zaman formu kullanılır.

advanced.q: She asserted that had the data been verified earlier, the scandal ____ averted.
advanced.explanation: Aktarılan bir cümle içinde gizli koşul (inversion) içeren yapıların geçmiş kipi korunur.

advanced.q: It was suggested that the board ____ the proposal until the fiscal audit was completed.
advanced.explanation: Öneri bildiren fiillerden sonra gelen 'that' cümleciğinde yalın fiil (subjunctive) kullanılır.

advanced.q: The scientist maintained that energy ____ neither created nor destroyed, but merely transformed.
advanced.explanation: Genel geçer bilimsel gerçekler rapor edilirken geniş zaman (present tense) korunur.

advanced.q: He claimed that by the time the authorities arrived, the suspects ____ the jurisdiction.
advanced.explanation: Aktarılan zamandan daha önce gerçekleşmiş bir eylem için past perfect tense tercih edilir.

advanced.q: The defense counsel argued that the witness's testimony ____ unreliable due to coercion.
advanced.explanation: Geçmişteki bir argüman aktarılırken ana fiil ile uyumlu olarak geçmiş zaman kullanılır.

advanced.q: It is imperative that the protocol ____ strictly observed during the investigation.
advanced.explanation: Zorunluluk bildiren resmi ifadelerde 'that' clauses içinde yalın fiil (subjunctive) kullanılır.

advanced.q: She admitted that she ____ the confidential documents to the press.
advanced.explanation: İtiraf edilen geçmiş eylem, ana fiilin zamanından daha önce olduğu için past perfect gerektirir.

advanced.q: The historian noted that had the alliance held, the war ____ for another year.
advanced.explanation: Geçmişteki gerçekleşmemiş ihtimallerin aktarımında 'might/could have' yapısı korunur.

advanced.q: They insisted that they ____ informed of the policy changes prior to implementation.
advanced.explanation: Israr bildiren fiillerden sonraki 'that' cümleciklerinde subjunctive (yalın fiil) tercih edilir.

advanced.q: The report indicated that inflation ____ steadily over the preceding two quarters.
advanced.explanation: Geçmişte başlayıp bir süre devam etmiş süreçler rapor edilirken past perfect continuous kullanılır.

advanced.q: He mentioned that he ____ the project by the end of the following week.
advanced.explanation: Gelecekteki bir zamana göre tamamlanmış olacak eylemler rapor edilirken 'would have' kullanılır.

advanced.q: The committee resolved that the motion ____ tabled until further notice.
advanced.explanation: Resmi kararlarda ve önerilerde 'that' cümleciğinde yalın fiil kullanımı kuraldır.

advanced.q: She confessed that no sooner ____ the room than the argument escalated.
advanced.explanation: Olumsuz zarfla başlayan devrik yapılar rapor edilen cümle içinde de devrik kalır.

advanced.q: The professor postulated that language acquisition ____ innate cognitive mechanisms.
advanced.explanation: Hâlâ geçerliliğini koruyan teorik önermeler aktarılırken geniş zaman kullanılabilir.

advanced.q: He stressed that whatever challenges ____, the mission must proceed as planned.
advanced.explanation: Resmi ve iddialı vurgularda ihtimal belirten modal yapıların geçmiş uyumu esnetilebilir.

advanced.q: The suspect declared that he ____ innocent of all charges brought against him.
advanced.explanation: Dolaylı aktarımlarda ana cümlenin geçmiş zamanına uyum sağlamak için 'was' kullanılır.

advanced.q: It was demanded that every participant ____ a nondisclosure agreement.
advanced.explanation: Talep bildiren resmi ifadelerde 'that' cümleciğinde yalın fiil formu zorunludur.

advanced.q: She pointed out that had they consulted an expert, the error ____ avoided.
advanced.explanation: Aktarılan koşullu yapının sonucunda 'could have' geçmiş anlamı korur.

basic.q: He asked me where I ____.
basic.explanation: Doğrudan soru dolaylı yapılırken zaman bir derece geçmişe kayar.

basic.q: She wanted to know if I ____ coffee.
basic.explanation: Dilekçe veya rica sorularında fiil past zamana dönüşür.

basic.q: They asked us what time the train ____.
basic.explanation: Geçmiş zamandaki bir soru aktarılırken fiil past olur.

basic.q: Can you tell me where ____?
basic.explanation: Dolaylı sorularda kelime sırası özne + fiil şeklinde normal cümle gibi olur.

basic.q: He asked me ____ I had a car.
basic.explanation: Evet-hayır soruları aktarılırken 'if' veya 'whether' kullanılır.

basic.q: She asked me why I ____ late.
basic.explanation: Özne 'I' olduğu için 'was' doğru formdur.

basic.q: I want to know how much ____.
basic.explanation: Dolaylı sorularda yardımcı fiil (do/does) düşer ve fiil -s alır.

basic.q: The teacher asked the students if they ____ their homework.
basic.explanation: Aktarılan sorularda past tense kullanımı gereklidir.

basic.q: Do you know where ____?
basic.explanation: Dolaylı sorularda 'does' kullanılmaz ve fiil çekimlenir.

basic.q: She asked me who ____ that book.
basic.explanation: Özne soran dolaylı sorularda kelime sırası değişmez, doğrudan past fiil gelir.

basic.q: He asked me ____ I could help him.
basic.explanation: 'If' yerine 'whether' da evet-hayır sorularında kullanılabilir.

basic.q: Could you tell me what time ____?
basic.explanation: Dolaylı soru yapısında özne fiilden önce gelir.

basic.q: She asked me what ____ doing.
basic.explanation: Aktarılan sorularda zaman geçmişe çekilir ve özne başa gelir.

basic.q: He asked me if I ____ speak English.
basic.explanation: Dolaylı konuşmada 'can' kelimesi 'could' olur.

basic.q: I'd like to know why ____ angry.
basic.explanation: Gömülü sorularda (embedded questions) özne fiilden önce gelir.

basic.q: They asked us where ____ going.
basic.explanation: Zaman uyumu nedeniyle 'are' yerine 'were' ve düz kelime sırası seçilir.

basic.q: She asked me how old ____.
basic.explanation: Aktarılan sorularda geçmiş zaman ve düz kelime dizilimi kullanılır.

basic.q: He asked me ____ I liked music.
basic.explanation: Yardımcı fiil ile başlayan sorular 'if' ile aktarılır.

basic.q: Can you tell me how much ____?
basic.explanation: Dolaylı sorularda 'is' fiili özneden sonra gelir.

basic.q: She asked me if I ____ seen the film.
basic.explanation: Present perfect tense ('have seen'), past perfect tense ('had seen') olur.

intermediate.q: He asked me ____ I had finished my report yet.
intermediate.explanation: Doğrudan olmayan evet/hayır sorularında 'if' veya 'whether' kullanılır.

intermediate.q: The manager wanted to know ____ we would arrive at the conference.
intermediate.explanation: Dolaylı sorularda soru kelimesinden sonra normal cümle dizilimi (özne + fiil) gelir.

intermediate.q: Can you tell me where ____?
intermediate.explanation: Nezaket sorularında dolaylı soru yapısı kullanıldığı için 'is' özneden sonra gelir.

intermediate.q: She asked her colleague why ____ leave the meeting early.
intermediate.explanation: Dolaylı sorularda zaman uyumuna dikkat edilir ve cümle yapısı olumlu cümle gibi dizilir.

intermediate.q: I wonder ____ they will accept our proposal or reject it.
intermediate.explanation: 'Or' bağlacı ile birlikte seçenek sunulduğunda 'whether' kullanımı daha uygundur.

intermediate.q: My supervisor asked me what ____ at the time of the incident.
intermediate.explanation: Dolaylı sorularda fiil geçmiş zamana kayar ve özne fiilden önce gelir.

intermediate.q: They inquired ____ the tickets were still available for tonight.
intermediate.explanation: Durum bildiren dolaylı evet/hayır sorularında 'if' bağlacı tercih edilir.

intermediate.q: Could you explain how ____ this software update?
intermediate.explanation: Dolaylı sorularda yardımcı fiil özneden önce değil, sonra yer alır.

intermediate.q: He asked me whose car ____ parked outside the office.
intermediate.explanation: 'Whose car' burada özne konumunda olduğu için doğrudan fiil ile devam eder.

intermediate.q: The interviewer wanted to know what experience ____ in marketing.
intermediate.explanation: Dolaylı soru yapısında soru kelimesinden sonra özne ve ardından fiil gelir.

intermediate.q: She asked me if ____ before.
intermediate.explanation: Dolaylı sorularda zaman bir derece geçmişe (Past Perfect) kayar ve özne önde olur.

intermediate.q: Do you know who ____ responsible for this project?
intermediate.explanation: Sorulan kişi özne olduğundan 'who' zamirinden sonra doğrudan fiil gelir.

intermediate.q: He asked me how long ____ waiting for the bus.
intermediate.explanation: Dolaylı sorularda zaman uyumu sağlanır ve özne fiilden önce yazılır.

intermediate.q: I asked her ____ she preferred tea or coffee.
intermediate.explanation: İki seçenek arasında tercih sorulduğunda 'whether' tercih edilir.

intermediate.q: The police officer asked us where ____ going at that late hour.
intermediate.explanation: Dolaylı sorularda kelime sırası 'özne + fiil' şeklinde olmalıdır.

intermediate.q: She asked me who ____ to see earlier today.
intermediate.explanation: Nesneye yönelik dolaylı sorularda 'özne + fiil' dizilimi uygulanır.

intermediate.q: Nobody told me ____ the meeting had been postponed.
intermediate.explanation: Bu yapı dolaylı bir soru değil, bir bilgi aktarımıdır; 'when' soru anlamı katar.

intermediate.q: He asked his boss whether ____ take a day off next week.
intermediate.explanation: Dolaylı sorularda modal fiiller de dahil olmak üzere özne fiilden önce gelir.

intermediate.q: Can you remember where ____ your keys?
intermediate.explanation: Dolaylı soru cümlesinde 'did' düşer ve ana fiil ikinci hale dönüşür.

intermediate.q: She inquired whether ____ possible to reschedule our appointment.
intermediate.explanation: Dolaylı evet/hayır sorularında 'whether' sonrasında düz cümle sırası ('it was') kullanılır.

advanced.q: Not a single committee member could recall what ____ when the sudden motion was introduced.
advanced.explanation: Dolaylı sorularda fiil özneye göre düz sıra (subject-verb) izler.

advanced.q: Little did the board know ____ the merger would eventually cost them in terms of autonomy.
advanced.explanation: Miktar bildiren dolaylı sorularda 'how much' yapısı kullanılır.

advanced.q: The diplomat politely inquired whether ____ possible to expedite the visa clearance process.
advanced.explanation: Dolaylı sorularda cümle yapısı olumlu cümle dizilimini korur.

advanced.q: Scarcely had the press conference begun ____ reporters started shouting aggressive questions about the scandal.
advanced.explanation: 'Scarcely... when' kalıbı doğru zaman uyumu ve bağlacı sağlar.

advanced.q: It remains a mystery to this day ____ the ancient manuscript disappeared from the secured vault.
advanced.explanation: Vurgu katan 'on earth' ifadesi soru kelimesinden hemen sonra gelir.

advanced.q: The auditor demanded to know ____ the discrepancies in the ledger had been addressed prior to his arrival.
advanced.explanation: 'Whether' dolaylı evet/hayır sorularında 'if' yerine resmi bağlamda tercih edilir.

advanced.q: Under no circumstances should you ask the CEO ____ the recent downsizing.
advanced.explanation: Aktarılan sorularda devrik yapı kullanılmaz, özne fiilden önce gelir.

advanced.q: Had the investigators known ____, they would have seized the digital archives immediately.
advanced.explanation: Yan cümle içindeki dolaylı soruda fiil özneden sonra gelir.

advanced.q: The CEO questioned the logic behind ____ the failing subsidiary.
advanced.explanation: Edatlardan sonra fiilimsi kullanılır, soru kelimesi bu bağlamda gereksizdir.

advanced.q: Professor Harrison asked us to consider ____ the universe is expanding at an accelerating rate.
advanced.explanation: Bilimsel belirsizlik belirten dolaylı sorularda 'whether' kullanılır.

advanced.q: Seldom do researchers agree on ____ the optimal sample size should be determined.
advanced.explanation: Yöntem bildiren dolaylı sorularda 'how' soru kelimesi uygundur.

advanced.q: The witness hesitated, unsure of ____ to answer the prosecutor's trick question truthfully.
advanced.explanation: 'Unsure whether to...' yapısı iki seçenekli kararsızlık durumlarında kullanılır.

advanced.q: Much to our dismay, the management never clarified ____ the budget cuts would affect our department.
advanced.explanation: Derece soran dolaylı sorularda 'to what extent' kalıbı kullanılır.

advanced.q: No sooner had the keynote speaker stepped off the stage ____ the audience rushed to mob him with inquiries.
advanced.explanation: 'No sooner' yapısı her zaman 'than' bağlacıyla eşleşir.

advanced.q: The detective asked the suspect ____ he had been at the exact time of the corporate espionage.
advanced.explanation: Dolaylı soru yapısında özne ve fiil sırası korunarak 'where on earth' kullanılır.

advanced.q: It is still debatable ____ the new monetary policy will curb runaway inflation.
advanced.explanation: Cümle başında 'whether' kullanımı 'if' seçeneğine göre daha resmi ve uygundur.

advanced.q: We were baffled as to ____ the board had rejected such a lucrative acquisition proposal.
advanced.explanation: Sebep sorgulayan dolaylı yapıda 'why' soru kelimesi gerekir.

advanced.q: Should any complications arise during the trial, you must immediately report ____.
advanced.explanation: Gelecekteki olası bir duruma yönelik aktarımda present perfect tense uygundur.

advanced.q: The historian tried to reconstruct ____ the ancient civilization managed to construct such massive megaliths.
advanced.explanation: Resmi dilde 'how' yerine 'by what means' dolaylı soru kalıbı tercih edilebilir.

advanced.q: Had anyone asked her opinion, she would have explained ____ the restructuring plan failed miserably.
advanced.explanation: Dolaylı sorularda doğrudan soru kelimesi olan 'why' bağlanma görevi görür.

basic.q: Complete the reported command: She told me, "Close the door." -> She told me ____ the door.
basic.explanation: Olumlu emirleri dolaylı aktarırken fiilden önce 'to' kullanılır.

basic.q: Complete the reported negative command: The teacher said, "Don't talk!" -> The teacher told us ____.
basic.explanation: Olumsuz emirleri aktarırken 'not to' yapısı kullanılır.

basic.q: My mother said to me, "Clean your room." -> My mother told me ____ my room.
basic.explanation: Emir cümleleri 'told + nesne + to + fiil' kuralıyla aktarılır.

basic.q: Choose the correct reported command for: He said, "Sit down, please."
options: He told me to sit down.
He told me for sit down.
basic.explanation: Doğrudan anlatımdaki emir cümlesi 'to sit down' şeklinde aktarılır.

basic.q: Find the error in this reported command: 'She told him to not touch the button.'
basic.explanation: Olumsuzluk eki 'to' kelimesinden önce değil, sonra gelmelidir ('not to').

basic.q: The police officer said, "Stop your car!" -> The officer told him ____ his car.
basic.explanation: Emir kipindeki fiil 'to stop' olarak değiştirilir.

basic.q: Complete the reported request: Dad said, "Open the window." -> Dad asked me ____ the window.
basic.explanation: Ricayı veya emri aktarırken 'to' infinitive yapısı tercih edilir.

basic.q: The doctor told me, "Eat more fruit." -> The doctor advised me ____ more fruit.
basic.explanation: Bildirilen ifadede 'to eat' yapısı kullanılmalıdır.

basic.q: Choose the correct negative command report: She said, "Don't be late!"
options: She told me don't be late.
She told me to not be late.
She told me not to be late.
She told me not be late.
basic.explanation: Olumsuz emirler 'not to' ile aktarılır.

basic.q: My friend said, "Wait for me." -> My friend told me ____ for him.
basic.explanation: Olumlu emir cümlelerinde 'to' ve fiilin yalın hali kullanılır.

basic.q: The boss said, "Don't be loud." -> The boss told us ____ loud.
basic.explanation: Doğru olumsuz emir aktarımı 'not to be' şeklindedir.

basic.q: Grandma said, "Eat your soup." -> Grandma told me ____ my soup.
basic.explanation: Emir fiili dolaylı anlatımda 'to eat' halini alır.

basic.q: Complete: The librarian said, "Be quiet." -> She told us ____ quiet.
basic.explanation: Fiil 'be' olduğu için 'to be' şeklinde aktarılır.

basic.q: Which sentence correctly reports: He said to her, "Listen to me."
options: He told her listen to him.
He told her to listen to him.
He told her listening to him.
He told her for listen to him.
basic.explanation: Emir cümlesi 'to listen' ile aktarılır ve zamirler uyarlanır.

basic.q: The guide said, "Don't take photos." -> The guide told us ____ photos.
basic.explanation: Olumsuz emirlerde 'not to' kalıbı kullanılır.

basic.q: Complete the gap: She told her son ____ his hands.
basic.explanation: Emir aktarımında 'to' ve fiilin birinci hali kullanılır.

basic.q: My sister said, "Read this book." -> She told me ____ that book.
basic.explanation: Dolaylı aktarılan emirlerde 'to read' yapısı kullanılır.

basic.q: Find the incorrect reported command: 'He told me to go home.'
basic.explanation: Cümle tamamen dil bilgisi kurallarına uygundur.

basic.q: The sign said, "Turn left." -> The sign told drivers ____ left.
basic.explanation: Emir cümlesi 'to turn' şeklinde dolaylı aktarılır.

basic.q: Complete: The coach said, "Run fast!" -> The coach told us ____ fast.
basic.explanation: Emir fiili aktarılırken önüne 'to' eklenir.

intermediate.q: The manager told us ____ leave the office before finishing the report.
intermediate.explanation: Dolaylı emir cümlelerinde olumsuzluk eklemek için 'not to' yapısı kullanılır.

intermediate.q: She instructed the new employee ____ his password with anyone.
intermediate.explanation: Olumsuz emirleri rapor ederken 'not to' ve fiilin yalın hali tercih edilir.

intermediate.q: Identify the error: The police officer ordered us (A) not to move (B) and stay (C) where we were (D).
intermediate.explanation: Emir kipindeki olumsuzluk ('not to') kendinden sonraki fiili de etkilediği için 'and to stay' olmalıdır.

intermediate.q: Doctor: 'Take this medicine twice a day.' -> The doctor advised me ____ that medicine twice a day.
intermediate.explanation: Doktorun tavsiyesini aktarırken 'advise someone to do something' yapısı kullanılır.

intermediate.q: Choose the correct transformation: 'Don't touch the wet paint!' shouted the painter.
options: The painter said not to touch the wet paint.
The painter told us don't touch the wet paint.
The painter ordered us not touching the wet paint.
The painter asked us to not touch the wet paint.
intermediate.explanation: Olumsuz bir emir 'told/ordered someone not to do something' şeklinde aktarılır.

intermediate.q: The security guard warned us ____ enter the restricted area without a badge.
intermediate.explanation: Uyarı içeren dolaylı komutlarda 'warn someone not to do' kalıbı kullanılır.

intermediate.q: Coach: 'Keep your eyes on the ball!' -> The coach shouted at the players ____ their eyes on the ball.
intermediate.explanation: Doğrudan emir cümleleri dolaylı aktarılırken 'to + infinitive' yapısına dönüştürülür.

intermediate.q: My mother reminded me ____ the stove before leaving the house.
intermediate.explanation: 'Remind' fiili ardından 'to' ile başlayan bir mastar alarak bir komutu veya hatırlatmayı aktarır.

intermediate.q: Identify the error: She begged him (A) to give her (B) another chance and (C) don't leave (D) her.
intermediate.explanation: Aktarılan olumsuz komutta 'don't leave' yerine 'not to leave' kullanılmalıdır.

intermediate.q: The instructor commanded the recruits ____ to attention immediately.
intermediate.explanation: Komut fiilleri ('command', 'order') nesneden sonra 'to' ve fiilin birinci halini alır.

intermediate.q: Which sentence correctly reports this command? 'Please submit your essays by Friday,' said the professor.
options: The professor told us submitting our essays by Friday.
The professor asked us to submit our essays by Friday.
The professor ordered us that we submit our essays by Friday.
The professor said to submit our essays by Friday.
intermediate.explanation: Nazikçe yapılan istekler 'ask someone to do something' kalıbıyla rapor edilir.

intermediate.q: The librarian told the students ____ loudly in the reading room.
intermediate.explanation: Kütüphanedeki yasaklama bildiren bir emir 'told someone not to speak' şeklinde aktarılır.

intermediate.q: Father: 'Never do that again!' -> My father warned me ____ that again.
intermediate.explanation: 'Never' kelimesi içeren emirlerde 'never to' yapısı 'to'dan önce veya sonra gelebilir ancak en yaygın ve doğru kullanım 'never to do' şeklindedir.

intermediate.q: Identify the error: The sign instructed visitors (A) to keep (B) off the grass and (C) do not pick (D) the flowers.
intermediate.explanation: Bağlaçla bağlanan ikinci olumsuz emir 'not to pick' şeklinde olmalıdır.

intermediate.q: The captain ordered the crew ____ their positions despite the storm.
intermediate.explanation: Emir fiili olan 'order' doğrudan 'to + infinitive' yapısını alır.

intermediate.q: Boss: 'Work harder if you want a promotion.' -> The boss urged us ____ harder if we wanted a promotion.
intermediate.explanation: 'Urge' fiili güçlü bir tavsiye veya komut bildirdiği için ardından 'to' alır.

intermediate.q: She forbade her children ____ outside after dark.
intermediate.explanation: 'Forbid' fiili anlam olarak zaten olumsuzluk içerdiği için ardından doğrudan olumlu mastar ('to play') alır.

intermediate.q: Choose the best completion: The receptionist asked us ____ a moment in the lobby.
intermediate.explanation: Ricada bulunurken 'ask someone to do something' kalıbı kullanılır.

intermediate.q: Identify the error: The tour guide advised us (A) to stay close (B) to the group and (C) don't wander off (D) alone.
intermediate.explanation: Aktarılan komuttaki olumsuzluk 'not to wander off' şeklinde ifade edilmelidir.

intermediate.q: The general commanded the soldiers ____ until he gave the signal.
intermediate.explanation: Askeri bir emrin olumsuz rapor edilişinde standart kural olarak 'not to' kullanılır.

advanced.q: It was urgently requested that no employee ____ the premises until the security audit was completed.
advanced.explanation: Talep ve emir bildiren (mandative) fiirlerden sonra 'that' cümçiğinde yalın fiir (base form) kullanılır.

advanced.q: The board decreed that the CEO ____ from all operational duties with immediate effect.
advanced.explanation: 'Decree' fiilinden sonra gelen 'that' yapısı yalın fiil gerektirir.

advanced.q: Should any delegate object to the motion, the chairperson instructed that the debate ____ adjourned.
advanced.explanation: Resmi emir ve talimat bildiren fiirlerin ardından gelen dolaylı anlatımlarda subjunctive (yalın fiil) tercih edilir.

advanced.q: The protocols dictate that whenever a system anomaly occurs, the operator ____ the backup server instantly.
advanced.explanation: Kural ve talimat bildiren 'dictate' fiilinden sonra yalın fiil kullanımı zorunludur.

advanced.q: Identify the error: 'The general commanded that the troops advance immediately and that no quarter be given.'
advanced.explanation: Cümledeki tüm emir ve talep yapıları kuralına uygun olarak yalın formda kullanılmıştır.

advanced.q: It is imperative that the research team ____ every variable before publishing the final thesis.
advanced.explanation: 'It is imperative that' kalıbı arkasından yalın fiil (subjunctive) gerektirir.

advanced.q: The magistrate ordered that the defendant ____ remanded in custody pending further forensic analysis.
advanced.explanation: Yargı makamlarının emir bildiren 'order' fiilinden sonra 'be' yardımcı fiilinin yalın hali kullanılır.

advanced.q: The university bylaws stipulate that every candidate ____ a portfolio of their published works.
advanced.explanation: 'Stipulate' fiili talep ve zorunluluk bildirdiği için kendinden sonraki cümlede yalın fiil ister.

advanced.q: Choose the best completion: The commanding officer gave strict orders that no soldier ____ the perimeter.
advanced.explanation: Emir kipinin dolaylı aktarımında veya mandative yapıda yalın fiil (leave) kullanılır.

advanced.q: It was proposed by the committee that the budget allocation ____ increased for the next fiscal year.
advanced.explanation: Öneri ve talep bildiren 'propose' fiilinin pasif kullanımından sonra 'be' kullanılır.

advanced.q: The guidelines explicitly demand that all manuscripts ____ to the editorial board via the online portal.
advanced.explanation: Talep bildiren 'demand' fiilinden sonra gelen pasif yapıda 'be' ve fiilin 3. hali kullanılır.

advanced.q: Identify the error: 'The director insisted that she takes on the lead role, despite her prior commitments.'
advanced.explanation: 'Insist' fiilinden sonra 'takes' yerine yalın fiil olan 'take' kullanılmalıdır.

advanced.q: The board of directors moved that the session ____ adjourned until a quorum could be established.
advanced.explanation: Öneri bildiren 'move' fiilinden sonraki yan cümlecikte yalın fiil ('be') tercih edilir.

advanced.q: It is crucial that the diplomat ____ utmost discretion during the confidential negotiations.
advanced.explanation: 'It is crucial that' kalıbı zorunluluk ve emir anlamı kattığı için fiil yalın halde olmalıdır.

advanced.q: The union demanded that the management ____ the proposed wage cuts immediately.
advanced.explanation: Talep bildiren 'demand' fiilinden sonra gelen fiil hiçbir ek almadan (yalın) kullanılmalıdır.

advanced.q: She strongly suggested that he ____ the contract without consulting a legal advisor first.
advanced.explanation: Mandative yapıların olumsuzunda 'not' doğrudan yalın fiilin önüne getirilir ('not sign').

advanced.q: Identify the error: 'The contract requires that each party fulfills their obligations punctually.'
advanced.explanation: 'Require' fiilinden sonra gelen 'fulfills' kelimesi yalın hal olan 'fulfill' olmalıdır.

advanced.q: The regulations mandate that no hazardous materials ____ transported without a specialized permit.
advanced.explanation: Yönetmelik emirlerinde mandative subjunctive kuralı gereği pasif yapıda 'be' kullanılır.

advanced.q: It is vital that every member of the expedition ____ thoroughly briefed on survival tactics.
advanced.explanation: 'It is vital that' kalıbından sonra gelen fiil yalın durumdadır ve 'be' olarak kalır.

advanced.q: The professor requested that the assignment ____ submitted in digital format by Friday noon.
advanced.explanation: Talep bildiren 'request' fiilinin ardından gelen pasif yapı 'be submitted' şeklindedir.

basic.q: She ____ me that she was happy.
basic.explanation: Nesne (me) aldığı için 'told'fiili kullanılmalıdır.

basic.q: He ____ that he liked ice cream.
basic.explanation: Doğrudan nesne almadığı için burada 'said' kullanılmalıdır.

basic.q: Mary ____ us to wait for her.
basic.explanation: Dolaylı rica bildiren fiillerden sonra nesne ile birlikte 'asked' kullanılır.

basic.q: They ____ they were tired.
basic.explanation: Arkasından nesne gelmediği için 'said' tercih edilir.

basic.q: John ____ me a interesting story.
basic.explanation: 'Me' nesnesini doğrudan alan fiil 'told'dur.

basic.q: The teacher ____ us to open our books.
basic.explanation: Emir veya talimat aktarırken 'told' veya 'asked' kullanılır, burada 'told' uygundur.

basic.q: Tom ____ that he would come tomorrow.
basic.explanation: Zarf cümlesinden önce nesnesiz kullanımda 'said' doğrudur.

basic.q: Can you ____ me the time?
basic.explanation: Birine bilgi verirken 'tell' fiili kullanılır.

basic.q: She ____ hello to everyone.
basic.explanation: 'Hello' gibi ifadelerle 'say' kullanılır.

basic.q: My mom ____ me not to run.
basic.explanation: Olumsuz bir talimatı aktarırken 'told' fiili nesne alarak kullanılır.

basic.q: He ____ that he was busy.
basic.explanation: Aktarılan cümleden önce nesne yoksa 'said' kullanılır.

basic.q: Who ____ you that secret?
basic.explanation: Birine bir sır vermek anlamında 'told' kullanılır.

basic.q: Lisa ____ goodbye and left.
basic.explanation: Veda etmek için 'say goodbye' kalıbı kullanılır.

basic.q: The police ____ us to stop.
basic.explanation: Birine bir şey yapmasını emrederken 'told' fiili uygundur.

basic.q: She ____ that she loved music.
basic.explanation: Nesne almadığı için 'said' doğru seçenektir.

basic.q: Please ____ the truth.
basic.explanation: Gerçeği söylemek için her zaman 'tell the truth' denir.

basic.q: He ____ he was hungry.
basic.explanation: Arkasından 'that' veya doğrudan cümle gelen durumlarda nesnesiz 'said' kullanılır.

basic.q: Anna ____ me a joke.
basic.explanation: Şaka anlatmak fiili 'tell a joke' şeklindedir.

basic.q: They ____ that the test was easy.
basic.explanation: Genel bir ifadeyi aktarırken nesne yoksa 'said' kullanılır.

basic.q: Did she ____ you her name?
basic.explanation: Soruda 'you' nesnesi olduğu için 'tell' fiili kullanılmalıdır.

intermediate.q: The manager ____ us not to touch the electrical equipment.
intermediate.explanation: Advise fiiri nesne alarak to-infinitive ile kullanılır.

intermediate.q: She ____ that she would help me with the presentation the following day.
intermediate.explanation: Promise fiiri 'that' cümleciği alarak doğrudan dolaylı anlatımda kullanılabilir.

intermediate.q: Mark ____ breaking the office window during the weekend.
intermediate.explanation: Deny fiiri suçlamayı kabul etmemek anlamında -ing yapısıyla kullanılır.

intermediate.q: My supervisor ____ me to finish the report before leaving the office.
intermediate.explanation: Remind fiiri birine bir şeyi hatırlatmak için nesne ve to-infinitive ile kullanılır.

intermediate.q: They ____ meeting the new clients at the airport the next morning.
intermediate.explanation: Suggest fiiri 'that' cümlesi veya doğrudan -ing formuyla kullanılır, nesne almaz.

intermediate.q: The police officer ____ the driver to step out of the car immediately.
intermediate.explanation: Order fiiri emir bildirdiği için nesne ve to-infinitive alır.

intermediate.q: Sarah ____ to pay for the broken vase, even though it was an accident.
intermediate.explanation: Offer fiiri gönüllü olma durumunu belirtmek için to-infinitive ile kullanılır.

intermediate.q: Tom ____ losing his temper during the intense discussion with the board.
intermediate.explanation: Admit fiiri bir hatayı veya durumu itiraf etmek için -ing ile kullanılır.

intermediate.q: The travel agent ____ us against visiting the old district at night.
intermediate.explanation: Warn fiiri bir tehlikeye karşı uyarmak için 'warn someone against -ing' veya 'warn someone not to' şeklinde kullanılır.

intermediate.q: Lucy ____ to help me carry the heavy boxes upstairs.
intermediate.explanation: Refuse fiiri bir şeyi yapmayı reddetmek anlamında to-infinitive alır.

intermediate.q: The doctor ____ me to cut down on fatty foods and exercise more.
intermediate.explanation: Advise fiiri nesne alarak to-infinitive ile kullanılır.

intermediate.q: John ____ on paying for dinner despite my protests.
intermediate.explanation: Insist fiiri ısrar etmek anlamında 'on' edatı ve -ing ile kullanılır.

intermediate.q: She ____ apologising to her colleague for the misunderstanding.
intermediate.explanation: Apologize fiiri 'for' edatı ile birlikte -ing yapısını alır.

intermediate.q: The director ____ that all employees attend the safety briefing.
intermediate.explanation: Demand fiiri 'that' cümleciği ile kullanılır ve genellikle subjunctive (yalın fiir) gerektirir.

intermediate.q: Andrew ____ me to his birthday party next weekend.
intermediate.explanation: Invite fiiri birini bir yere davet etmek için nesne ve to-infinitive alır.

intermediate.q: They ____ to leak the confidential information if their demands were not met.
intermediate.explanation: Threaten fiiri tehdit etmek anlamında to-infinitive ile kullanılır.

intermediate.q: The weather forecast ____ that it would rain heavily later in the afternoon.
intermediate.explanation: Predict fiiri gelecekteki bir durumu tahmin etmek ve bildirmek için 'that' ile kullanılır.

intermediate.q: He ____ that he had never seen the stolen document before.
intermediate.explanation: Maintain fiiri bir iddianın arkasında durmak ve ısrarla savunmak anlamında 'that' ile kullanılır.

intermediate.q: The guide ____ exploring the narrow streets of the old town on foot.
intermediate.explanation: Recommend fiiri nesnesiz kullanıldığında doğrudan -ing alır.

intermediate.q: Jane ____ me of not taking the project seriously enough.
intermediate.explanation: Accuse fiiri 'of' edatı ile birlikte -ing yapısını alır.

advanced.q: The board of directors ____ that the merger should proceed without delay, despite minor opposition.
advanced.explanation: Insist fiiri 'should' kalıbıyla birlikte güçlü bir tavsiye veya talep bildirmek için kullanılır.

advanced.q: The defense attorney ____ the witness of having concealed crucial evidence from the court.
advanced.explanation: Accuse fiiri 'of' edatı ile birlikte suçlama bildirmek için doğru kalıptır.

advanced.q: Dr. Henderson ____ that further research was paramount before drawing any definitive conclusions.
advanced.explanation: Maintain fiiri, bir fikri veya argümanı ısrarla savunmak anlamında raporlama fiili olarak kullanılır.

advanced.q: The union leader ____ the management of acting in bad faith during the protracted negotiations.
advanced.explanation: Charge fiiri 'with' edatı alarak resmi veya kurumsal suçlamalarda kullanılır.

advanced.q: Rather than confessing outright, the politician merely ____ at a possible resignation.
advanced.explanation: Hint fiiri 'at' edatı ile dolaylı olarak ima etmek anlamında kullanılır.

advanced.q: The witness ____ having seen the suspect near the scene of the crime on the night in question.
advanced.explanation: Deny fiiri gerund (-ing) yapısıyla birlikte bir durumu inkâr etmek için kullanılır.

advanced.q: The professor ____ the undergraduates against plagiarizing their final dissertations.
advanced.explanation: Warn fiiri 'against' edatı ile olası bir tehlikeye karşı uyarıda bulunmak için kullanılır.

advanced.q: Local residents ____ that the proposed industrial plant would irreparably damage the ecosystem.
advanced.explanation: Contend fiiri, iddia etmek veya savunmak anlamında resmi bağlamda kullanılır.

advanced.q: The diplomat ____ any involvement in the clandestine operation.
advanced.explanation: Disclaim fiiri sorumluluğu veya bağlantıyı resmi olarak reddetmek için tercih edilir.

advanced.q: The CEO ____ the employees to exercise utmost discretion regarding the upcoming acquisition.
advanced.explanation: Urge fiiri nesne alarak birini güçlü bir şekilde teşvik etmek veya nasihat etmek için kullanılır.

advanced.q: The expert ____ that the fluctuating market trends were indicative of a looming recession.
advanced.explanation: Suggest fiiri 'that' cümleciği ile birlikte bir görüş veya olasılık öne sürmek için uygundur.

advanced.q: Despite mounting pressure, the minister ____ to disclose the source of the leaked document.
advanced.explanation: Refuse fiiri infinitive (to do) alarak bir şeyi yapmayı reddetmek anlamını verir.

advanced.q: The prosecution ____ that the defendant had premeditated the crime weeks in advance.
advanced.explanation: Argue fiiri hukuki veya akademik bağlamda tez savunmak için 'that' ile kullanılır.

advanced.q: The renowned historian ____ having neglected the socio-economic context in her previous monograph.
advanced.explanation: Acknowledge fiiri bir gerçeği kabul etmek anlamında gerund alabilir.

advanced.q: The committee ____ that the funding be allocated immediately to the affected sectors.
advanced.explanation: Tavsiye ve talep bildiren bu fiillerin hepsi 'that' cümleciğinde subjunctive (yalın fiil) yapı gerektirir.

advanced.q: She ____ ignorance of the new corporate regulations during the compliance audit.
advanced.explanation: Profess ignorance kalıbı, bir şeyden habersiz olduğunu iddia etmek/öne sürmek için kullanılır.

advanced.q: The environmental group ____ the government for failing to meet its carbon emission targets.
advanced.explanation: Criticize fiiri 'for' edatı ile birlikte eleştiri bildirmek için doğru kalıptır.

advanced.q: The spokesperson ____ rumors of an impending merger, calling them entirely baseless.
advanced.explanation: Dismiss fiiri, iddiaları veya söylentileri önemsiz bularak reddetmek/geçiştirmek anlamındadır.

advanced.q: The detective ____ that the suspect was lying based on subtle inconsistencies in his testimony.
advanced.explanation: Infer fiiri, mevcut verilerden sonuç çıkararak rapor etmek için kullanılır.

advanced.q: The mayor ____ responsibility for the infrastructural collapse during the severe storm.
advanced.explanation: Accept responsibility kalıbı, sorumluluğu üstlenmek anlamında en yaygın kullanımdır.

basic.q: He said, 'I am tired.' -> He said that he ____ tired.
basic.explanation: Doğrudan anlatımdaki 'am' fiili, aktarım cümlesinde geçmiş zamana dönüşerek 'was' olur.

basic.q: She said, 'I like apples.' -> She said that she ____ apples.
basic.explanation: Geniş zaman (Present Simple), aktarım cümlesinde geçmiş zamana (Past Simple) dönüşür.

basic.q: Tom said, 'I play tennis.' -> Tom said that he ____ tennis.
basic.explanation: Geniş zamanlı fiil 'play', aktarıldığında ikinci hali olan 'played' yapılır.

basic.q: Mary said, 'I am reading a book.' -> Mary said she ____ a book.
basic.explanation: Şimdiki zaman (Present Continuous), aktarımda geçmiş şimdiki zaman (Past Continuous) olan 'was reading' olur.

basic.q: John said, 'I live in London.' -> John said that he ____ in London.
basic.explanation: 'Live' fiili aktarıldığında geçmiş zaman olan 'lived' haline gelir.

basic.q: Anna said, 'I have a cat.' -> Anna said that she ____ a cat.
basic.explanation: 'Have' fiilinin geçmiş zamandaki karşılığı 'had'dir.

basic.q: Dad said, 'I am hungry.' -> Dad said that he ____ hungry.
basic.explanation: Aktarım yapılırken 'am' fiili 'was' olarak değiştirilir.

basic.q: Sue said, 'I work hard.' -> Sue said that she ____ hard.
basic.explanation: Geniş zaman fiili 'work', aktarıldığında 'worked' olur.

basic.q: He said, 'I can swim.' -> He said that he ____ swim.
basic.explanation: 'Can' modal fiili, dolaylı anlatımda geçmiş zamanı olan 'could' kelimesine dönüşür.

basic.q: She said, 'I will call you.' -> She said that she ____ call me.
basic.explanation: 'Will' kelimesi aktarım cümlesinde 'would' yapılır.

basic.q: Ben said, 'I am eating lunch.' -> Ben said he ____ lunch.
basic.explanation: 'Am eating' ifadesi geçmiş zamana uyarlanarak 'was eating' olur.

basic.q: Kate said, 'I speak English.' -> Kate said she ____ English.
basic.explanation: 'Speak' fiilinin past hali olan 'spoke' kullanılır.

basic.q: Paul said, 'I love music.' -> Paul said that he ____ music.
basic.explanation: Geniş zaman 'love', aktarımda 'loved' şeklini alır.

basic.q: Jane said, 'I want a pen.' -> Jane said she ____ a pen.
basic.explanation: Aktarılan cümlede 'want' fiili geçmiş zaman olan 'wanted' yapılır.

basic.q: Mark said, 'I am happy.' -> Mark said he ____ happy.
basic.explanation: Aktarılan konuşmada 'am' fiili 'was' ile değiştirilir.

basic.q: Lucy said, 'I drink milk.' -> Lucy said that she ____ milk.
basic.explanation: 'Drink' fiilinin ikinci hali 'drank' olarak aktarılır.

basic.q: Sam said, 'I watch TV.' -> Sam said that he ____ TV.
basic.explanation: Geniş zamandaki 'watch' fiili, aktarıldığında 'watched' olur.

basic.q: Tina said, 'I am cooking dinner.' -> Tina said she ____ dinner.
basic.explanation: 'Am cooking' kalıbı dolaylı anlatımda 'was cooking' şeklinde değişir.

basic.q: Dan said, 'I have a car.' -> Dan said that he ____ a car.
basic.explanation: Aktarılan ifadede 'have' fiili geçmiş zaman olan 'had' olur.

basic.q: Rose said, 'I know the answer.' -> Rose said she ____ the answer.
basic.explanation: 'Know' fiili aktarılırken geçmiş zamandaki 'knew' haline döner.

intermediate.q: "I will finish the report tomorrow," she said. -> She said that she would finish the report ____.
intermediate.explanation: Dolaylı anlatımda tomorrow ifadesi the next day olarak değiştirilir.

intermediate.q: "We were living in Paris when the war started," they told us. -> They told us that they ____ in Paris when the war started.
intermediate.explanation: Past continuous tense, dolaylı anlatımda past perfect continuous tense e dönüşür.

intermediate.q: "I bought this car last year," Mark said. -> Mark said that he had bought that car ____.
intermediate.explanation: Last year ifadesi reported speech te the previous year olur.

intermediate.q: "If I had more time, I would travel more," she said. -> She said that if she ____ more time, she would travel more.
intermediate.explanation: Type 2 conditional cümlelerinde tense değişimi yapılmaz, past simple aynı kalır.

intermediate.q: "Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius," the teacher explained. -> The teacher explained that water ____ at 100 degrees Celsius.
intermediate.explanation: Genel geçer bilimsel gerçeklerde tense değişimi yapılmaz, geniş zaman korunur.

intermediate.q: "I have already eaten dinner," he told me. -> He told me that he ____ already eaten dinner.
intermediate.explanation: Present perfect tense, dolaylı anlatımda past perfect tense e dönüşür.

intermediate.q: "Can you help me with this heavy box?" she asked. -> She asked me if I ____ help her with that heavy box.
intermediate.explanation: Modallarda can fiili reported speech te could şekline dönüşür.

intermediate.q: "I must submit the assignment by Friday," John said. -> John said that he ____ submit the assignment by Friday.
intermediate.explanation: Zorunluluk bildiren must fiili dolaylı anlatımda genellikle had to olur.

intermediate.q: "Where did you leave your keys?" he asked me. -> He asked me where ____ left my keys.
intermediate.explanation: Soru cümleleri dolaylı anlatımda düz cümle haline gelir ve tense geri kayar.

intermediate.q: "Don't touch the hot stove!" the mother said to the child. -> The mother told the child ____ the hot stove.
intermediate.explanation: Olumsuz emir cümleleri reported speech te not to ile başlar.

intermediate.q: "I'm meeting my friends here tonight," Lisa said. -> Lisa said that she ____ her friends there that night.
intermediate.explanation: Present continuous tense, dolaylı anlatımda past continuous tense e dönüşür.

intermediate.q: "I will have finished the project by next Monday," he promised. -> He promised that he ____ finished the project by the following Monday.
intermediate.explanation: Future perfect tense, reported speech te would have yapısına dönüşür.

intermediate.q: "You should see a doctor," she told him. -> She advised him ____ a doctor.
intermediate.explanation: Tavsiye bildiren should yapısı advised + object + to infinitive ile aktarılır.

intermediate.q: "I may come to the party later," Tom said. -> Tom said that he ____ come to the party later.
intermediate.explanation: May kipi dolaylı anlatımda might şekline dönüşür.

intermediate.q: "Close the window, please," she said to him. -> She asked him ____ the window.
intermediate.explanation: Rica ve emir cümleleri to infinitive yapısı ile aktarılır.

intermediate.q: "I was walking in the park when I saw the accident," she explained. -> She explained that she ____ in the park when she saw the accident.
intermediate.explanation: Past continuous tense, dolaylı anlatımda past perfect continuous tense e dönüşür.

intermediate.q: "Are you enjoying the concert?" he asked me. -> He asked me ____ the concert.
intermediate.explanation: Evet-hayır soruları if/whether ile bağlanır ve tense ile özne sırası düz cümle kuralına uyar.

intermediate.q: "I haven't seen Sarah since last week," David remarked. -> David remarked that he ____ Sarah since the previous week.
intermediate.explanation: Present perfect negative tense, dolaylı anlatımda past perfect negative e dönüşür.

intermediate.q: "We had already eaten when you arrived," they told us. -> They told us that they ____ already eaten when we arrived.
intermediate.explanation: Past perfect tense dolaylı anlatımda aynı kalır (değişmez).

intermediate.q: "Shall we open a window?" he suggested. -> He suggested ____ a window.
intermediate.explanation: Suggest fiilinden sonra fiil -ing takısı alır veya that clause kullanılır.

advanced.q: The historian noted that if the treaty ____ ratified the previous year, the war would have been avoided.
advanced.explanation: Geçmiş zamandaki birinci derece şartlı cümleler Reported Speech içinde bir derece daha geçmişe (Past Perfect) kaydırılır.

advanced.q: She remarked that she ____ finishing the thesis by the time the committee convened the following week.
advanced.explanation: Gelecekteki tamamlanmış eylemlerin bildirilmesinde 'future-in-the-past' yapısı olarak 'would have' tercih edilir.

advanced.q: The professor explained that water ____ at 100 degrees Celsius under standard atmospheric pressure.
advanced.explanation: Genel geçer doğrularda ve bilimsel gerçeklerde Reported Speech yapılırken tense değişimi yapılmaz.

advanced.q: They complained that the equipment ____ properly since it was installed a month prior.
advanced.explanation: Geçmişte belirli bir noktadan öncesine uzanan süreçler için Past Perfect Continuous tense kullanılır.

advanced.q: He stated that had he known about the budget cuts, he ____ for the promotion.
advanced.explanation: Third conditional yapıları Reported Speech'e aktarılırken tense yapısı korunur ve 'wouldn't have applied' olur.

advanced.q: The CEO insisted that the board ____ informed immediately whenever such a crisis arose.
advanced.explanation: Israr bildiren fiillerden sonra gelen 'that' cümleciklerinde subjunctive ( yalın hal ) kullanılır, tense değişmez.

advanced.q: She mentioned that she ____ in London for five years when she finally decided to move to Paris.
advanced.explanation: Bildirilen zamandan daha önce başlayıp süregelen geçmiş durumlar Past Perfect tense ile aktarılır.

advanced.q: The witness testified that he ____ the suspect leaving the building at midnight.
advanced.explanation: Belirli bir geçmiş zamanda tamamlanmış eylemler bazen vurgu ve anlam kaybını önlemek için Simple Past olarak kalabilir.

advanced.q: It was argued by the defense counsel that the accused ____ elsewhere when the robbery took place.
advanced.explanation: Eş zamanlı devam eden geçmişteki durumlar aktarılırken genellikle Simple Past tense korunur.

advanced.q: The journalist reported that negotiations ____ if the government refused to compromise.
advanced.explanation: Doğrudan anlatımdaki 'will', dolaylı anlatımda 'would' şekline dönüştürülür.

advanced.q: The manual specified that users ____ the device unless they had unplugged it first.
advanced.explanation: Yönerge ve kurallarda 'must' fiili dolaylı aktarımda genellikle 'should' olarak değişir.

advanced.q: She whispered that she ____ rather not discuss the confidential matter in public.
advanced.explanation: 'Would rather' yapısı Reported Speech dönüşümlerinde formunu korur.

advanced.q: The astronomer mentioned that light ____ at a constant speed of about 300,000 kilometers per second.
advanced.explanation: Evrensel bir gerçek aktarıldığı için Simple Present tense değişmeden kalır.

advanced.q: He admitted that he ____ about his qualifications during the interview the previous week.
advanced.explanation: Bildirim anından daha önce yapılmış olan itiraf niteliğindeki eylem Past Perfect tense ile aktarılır.

advanced.q: The board recommended that the proposal ____ rejected due to insufficient financial backing.
advanced.explanation: Tavsiye ve öneri bildiren fiillerden sonraki 'that' cümleciklerinde subjunctive 'be' kullanımı korunur.

advanced.q: She stated that by the time her colleagues arrived, she ____ all the necessary reports.
advanced.explanation: Geçmişteki bir noktadan önce tamamlanmış olan eylemler Past Perfect ile ifade edilir.

advanced.q: The consultant suggested that we ____ alternative suppliers before finalizing the contract.
advanced.explanation: Öneri fiillerinden sonra gelen 'that' cümlelerinde fiil yalın halde (subjunctive) kalır.

advanced.q: He noted that the Roman Empire ____ in the West during the fifth century AD.
advanced.explanation: Tarihsel bir olay spesifik bir zaman zarfıyla verildiğinde Simple Past tense korunur.

advanced.q: The supervisor indicated that the project ____ completed by Friday, regardless of the delays.
advanced.explanation: Zorunluluk bildiren 'must' geçmişe aktarılırken 'had to' şekline dönüşür.

advanced.q: They pointed out that if the weather ____ favorable, they would have set sail earlier.
advanced.explanation: Third conditional içeren dolaylı anlatımlarda şart kısmı Past Perfect ile ifade edilir.

basic.q: He said, 'I am busy today.' In reported speech, today becomes ____.
basic.explanation: Reported speech kuralina gore today kelimesi that day olur.

basic.q: She said, 'I saw him yesterday.' Yesterday changes to ____ in reported speech.
basic.explanation: Gecmis zamandaki yesterday ifadesi reported speech te the day before olarak degisir.

basic.q: Tom said, 'I will leave tomorrow.' Tomorrow changes to ____.
basic.explanation: Gelecek zamani belirten tomorrow ifadesi the next day olur.

basic.q: Mary said, 'I bought this car last week.' Last week changes to ____.
basic.explanation: Last week ifadesi reported speech te the previous week seklinde degistirilir.

basic.q: John said, 'I am leaving now.' Now becomes ____ in reported speech.
basic.explanation: Now zarfi reported speech yapilirken then kelimesine donusur.

basic.q: They said, 'We arrived here yesterday.' Here changes to ____.
basic.explanation: Yer zarfi olan here kelimesi reported speech te there olur.

basic.q: Anna said, 'I will call you next month.' Next month changes to ____.
basic.explanation: Next month ifadesi reported speech te the following month olur.

basic.q: He told me, 'I met her three days ago.' Ago changes to ____.
basic.explanation: Ago kelimesi reported speech te before olarak degisir.

basic.q: Which time expression is correct for reported speech if direct speech uses 'tonight'?
basic.explanation: Tonight ifadesi reported speech te that night sekline donusur.

basic.q: She said, 'I am reading this book now.' This changes to ____ in reported speech.
basic.explanation: Isaret zamiri olan this kelimesi reported speech te that olur.

basic.q: He said, 'I lost my keys yesterday.' Find the correct reported version of the time expression.
basic.explanation: Yesterday ifadesi reported speech te the day before olur.

basic.q: They said, 'We are moving next year.' Next year becomes ____.
basic.explanation: Next year ifadesi reported speech te the following year olur.

basic.q: Jane said, 'I am happy today.' Today changes to ____.
basic.explanation: Today kelimesi reported speech kurallarina gore that day olur.

basic.q: Paul said, 'I finished my project two hours ago.' Ago becomes ____.
basic.explanation: Ago kelimesi reported speech icinde before kelimesine donusur.

basic.q: She said, 'I will see him tomorrow.' Tomorrow changes to ____.
basic.explanation: Tomorrow ifadesi reported speech te the next day olarak degisir.

basic.q: He said, 'I live here.' Here changes to ____ in reported speech.
basic.explanation: Here kelimesi reported speech kurallarina gore there olur.

basic.q: Sue said, 'I bought these shoes last week.' Last week becomes ____.
basic.explanation: Last week ifadesi reported speech te the previous week seklini alir.

basic.q: Bob said, 'I am eating dinner now.' Now changes to ____.
basic.explanation: Now kelimesi reported speech te then olarak degisir.

basic.q: The teacher said, 'We have a test tomorrow.' Tomorrow changes to ____.
basic.explanation: Tomorrow ifadesi reported speech te the following day olabilir.

basic.q: Kate said, 'I lost my umbrella yesterday.' Yesterday becomes ____.
basic.explanation: Yesterday kelimesi reported speech te the day before olur.

intermediate.q: John said, 'I will finish this report tomorrow.' -> John said that he would finish that report ____.
intermediate.explanation: Reported speech kurallarına göre 'tomorrow' ifadesi 'the next day' olarak değiştirilir.

intermediate.q: Mary told me, 'I met my advisor yesterday.' -> Mary told me that she had met her advisor ____.
intermediate.explanation: Reported speech'te 'yesterday' ifadesi 'the day before' veya 'the previous day' olur.

intermediate.q: Tom remarked, 'We are moving to a new house now.' -> Tom remarked that they were moving to a new house ____.
intermediate.explanation: Reported speech'te 'now' zaman zarfı 'then' kelimesine dönüşür.

intermediate.q: She explained, 'I bought this laptop last week.' -> She explained that she had bought that laptop ____.
intermediate.explanation: 'Last week' ifadesi aktarılan konuşmada 'the previous week' ya da 'the week before' olur.

intermediate.q: Identify the error in reported speech: He said that he had seen the film two days ago.
intermediate.explanation: Reported speech içinde 'ago' kelimesi 'before' olarak değiştirilmelidir.

intermediate.q: The manager announced, 'We will launch the new product next month.' -> The manager announced that they would launch the new product ____.
intermediate.explanation: 'Next month' ifadesi reported speech'te 'the following month' olarak değişir.

intermediate.q: Anna noted, 'I am staying here for the weekend.' -> Anna noted that she was staying ____ for the weekend.
intermediate.explanation: Yer zarfı olan 'here' kelimesi reported speech kurallarına göre 'there' olur.

intermediate.q: David stated, 'I have lived in this city for five years.' -> David stated that he had lived in ____ city for five years.
intermediate.explanation: İşaret sıfatı olan 'this' kelimesi reported speech'te 'that' olarak değiştirilir.

intermediate.q: Choose the correct transformation for today: 'I am busy today,' she said. -> She said that she was busy ____.
intermediate.explanation: 'Today' zaman ifadesi reported speech aktarımında 'that day'e dönüşür.

intermediate.q: Paul said, 'I finished my project tonight.' -> Paul said that he had finished his project ____.
intermediate.explanation: 'Tonight' ifadesi reported speech kuralları gereği 'that night' olarak değiştirilir.

intermediate.q: Identify the incorrect time shift: 'I spoke to him three days ago.' -> He said he had spoken to him three days before.
intermediate.explanation: Dönüşüm doğrudur: 'ago' kelimesi 'before' olmuştur ve zaman 'past perfect'e kaymıştır.

intermediate.q: Sophie claimed, 'These books belong to me.' -> Sophie claimed that ____ books belonged to her.
intermediate.explanation: Çoğul işaret sıfatı 'these', reported speech aktarımında 'those' olur.

intermediate.q: Mark told us, 'I will call you tonight.' -> Mark told us that he would call us ____.
intermediate.explanation: 'Tonight' kelimesi reported speech içinde 'that night' şeklinde değiştirilir.

intermediate.q: Rachel said, 'I was working until late last night.' -> Rachel said that she had been working until late ____.
intermediate.explanation: 'Last night' ifadesi reported speech dönüşümünde 'the previous night' veya 'the night before' olur.

intermediate.q: Complete the sentence correctly: He said that he was meeting his client ____.
options: Both B and C are correct
intermediate.explanation: Reported speech'te 'now' yerine hem 'then' hem de 'at that time' kullanılabilir.

intermediate.q: Lucas mentioned, 'I am leaving for Paris tomorrow morning.' -> Lucas mentioned that he was leaving for Paris ____.
intermediate.explanation: 'Tomorrow morning' ifadesi reported speech'te 'the following morning' veya 'the next morning' olur.

intermediate.q: Find the error in the reported sentence: She said that she would submit the report two days ago.
intermediate.explanation: Gelecek zamana ait bir aktarımda 'ago' kullanılamaz, 'before' kullanılmalıdır.

intermediate.q: Emma stated, 'I have been here since this morning.' -> Emma stated that she had been there since ____ morning.
intermediate.explanation: 'This morning' ifadesindeki 'this', reported speech dönüşümünde 'that morning' olur.

intermediate.q: The guide instructed, 'Do not take photos here.' -> The guide instructed us not to take photos ____.
intermediate.explanation: Emir cümlelerinin aktarımında da 'here' kelimesi 'there' olarak değiştirilir.

intermediate.q: Oliver explained, 'I saw him two years ago.' -> Oliver explained that he had seen him two years ____.
intermediate.explanation: Zaman zarfı olan 'ago' kelimesi reported speech kurallarına göre 'before' kelimesine dönüşür.

advanced.q: She remarked that the conference scheduled for the following week had been postponed, which implies that in direct speech she originally said ____.
advanced.explanation: Dolaylı aktarımda kullanılan 'the following week', doğrudan konuşmada 'next week' ifadesine karşılık gelir.

advanced.q: Identify the incorrect transformation from direct to reported speech: Direct: "We implemented the new compliance policy yesterday." Reported: He stated that they had implemented the new compliance policy ____.
advanced.explanation: 'Yesterday', dolaylı aktarımda 'that yesterday' şeklinde değil, 'the previous day' veya 'the day before' olarak değiştirilir.

advanced.q: In a formal deposition, the witness testified that the transaction had taken place two days ____.
advanced.explanation: Dolaylı aktarımda 'two days ago' ifadesi genellikle 'two days before' veya 'two days previously' olarak değişir, ancak 'before' bu bağlamda en yaygın standarttır.

advanced.q: Choosing the correct temporal shift for a historical quote reported years later: Direct: "Rome was not built in a day." Reported: The historian noted that Rome ____ built in a day.
advanced.explanation: Genel geçer doğrular ve atasözleri aktarılırken zaman ve zaman ifadesi genellikle değiştirilmez.

advanced.q: Direct: "I am submitting my resignation effective tonight." Reported: He announced that he was submitting his resignation effective ____.
advanced.explanation: Dolaylı aktarımda 'tonight' kelimesi 'that night' olarak değiştirilir.

advanced.q: Which of the following correctly reports 'We are launching the product as of this morning' spoken earlier today?
options: They stated they were launching the product as of that morning.
They stated they are launching the product as of this morning.
They stated they had launched the product as of these mornings.
They stated they were launching the product as of now morning.
advanced.explanation: Konuşmanın yapıldığı gün içinde aktarım yapılırken 'this morning' bazen aynı kalabilir ancak resmi kurallarda 'that morning' tercih edilir.

advanced.q: Direct: "The audit will commence twelve months from now." Reported: The CEO explained that the audit would commence twelve months ____.
advanced.explanation: Dolaylı aktarımda 'from now' ifadesi 'from then' veya 'twelve months later' şeklinde değiştirilir.

advanced.q: Spot the error in this advanced reported speech sentence: 'She mentioned that she had finalised the quarterly report ____.'
advanced.explanation: Dolaylı aktarılan bir cümlede 'this afternoon' zamansal olarak geriye çekilmeli veya 'that afternoon' yapılmalıdır.

advanced.q: Direct: "I finished my dissertation a fortnight ago." Reported: The candidate stated that she had finished her dissertation a fortnight ____.
advanced.explanation: Dolaylı aktarım kurallarına göre 'ago' ifadesi 'before' kelimesine dönüşür.

advanced.q: When reporting a statement made years ago where the time frame is still relevant, which option best reflects advanced usage? Direct: "We started this enterprise in 2010." Reported: He explained that they ____ that enterprise in 2010.
advanced.explanation: Belirli bir geçmiş zaman (2010) verildiğinde, dolaylı aktarımda zaman ifadesi değişmez, yalnızca fiil 'had started' yapılabilir veya 'started' kalabilir, ancak zaman zarfı gerektiren durumlarda özel bir değişim aranmaz.

advanced.q: Direct: "These statistics are valid only for the present quarter." Reported: The analyst argued that those statistics were valid only for ____.
advanced.explanation: Resmi ve edebi dilde 'the present' kelimesi dolaylı aktarımda 'the then' şeklinde değiştirilir.

advanced.q: Choose the correct reporting of: "I will address the board later today." -> He promised that he would address the board ____.
advanced.explanation: 'Today' kelimesi 'that day' olur ve 'later today' ifadesi 'later that day' şeklini alır.

advanced.q: Direct: "We are meeting up here tomorrow." Reported: They noted that they were meeting up ____.
advanced.explanation: Hem yer hem de zaman zarflarının ('here' -> 'there', 'tomorrow' -> 'the following day') doğru değiştirildiği seçenek budur.

advanced.q: Direct: "I haven't seen any improvement thus far." Reported: The patient complained that she hadn't seen any improvement ____.
advanced.explanation: 'Thus far' veya 'until now' ifadeleri dolaylı aktarımda 'up to that time' veya 'hitherto' (korunarak) şeklinde uyarlanır.

advanced.q: Direct: "The merger will take effect as of now." Reported: The chairman announced that the merger would take effect as of ____.
advanced.explanation: Dolaylı aktarımda 'now' kelimesi 'then' veya 'at that time' olarak değiştirilir.

advanced.q: Which option correctly completes the reported form of: 'We implemented the protocol years ago'? -> She explained that they had implemented the protocol years ____.
advanced.explanation: 'Years ago' ifadesi dolaylı aktarımda 'years before' şeklinde değiştirilir.

advanced.q: Direct: "I shall reply to your memo by the end of this week." Reported: He promised that he would reply to my memo by the end of ____.
advanced.explanation: Dolaylı aktarımda 'this week' ifadesi 'that week' olarak değiştirilir.

advanced.q: Direct: "The laboratory results came in just minutes ago." Reported: The scientist stated that the laboratory results had come in just minutes ____.
advanced.explanation: 'Minutes ago' gibi kısa süreler için dolaylı aktarımda genellikle 'earlier' veya 'before' kullanılır, 'earlier' bu bağlamda çok yaygındır.

advanced.q: Direct: "We are experiencing technical difficulties at present." Reported: The broadcast stated that they were experiencing technical difficulties ____.
advanced.explanation: Dolaylı aktarımda 'at present' ifadesi 'at that time' veya 'then' olarak değiştirilir.

advanced.q: Identify the proper transformation: Direct: "I will review the contract next month." Reported: She stated that she would review the contract ____.
advanced.explanation: 'Next month' ifadesi dolaylı aktarımda 'the following month' veya 'the month after' şeklinde değiştirilir.
